        function exportToExcel() {
            document.getElementById('exportMenu').classList.remove('show');
            
            const activePassengers = passengers.filter(p => p.status === 'active' || !p.status);
            
            if (activePassengers.length === 0) {
                showToast('אין נוסעים לייצוא', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            // Prepare data for Excel
            const headers = ['#', 'שם פרטי', 'שם משפחה', 'סוכן', 'מלון', 'קוד מלון', 'קבוצת חדר', 'הלוך', 'חזור', 'מטבע', 'מחיר', 'עלות', 'עמלה', 'דוקט טופ', 'טלפון', 'מספר הזמנה', 'הערות'];
            
            const rows = activePassengers.map((p, i) => [
                i + 1,
                p.first_name || '',
                p.last_name || '',
                p.agent_name || '',
                p.hotel_name || '',
                p.hotel_booking_ref || '',
                p.room_group_name || '',
                p.has_outbound !== false ? 'V' : '',
                p.has_return !== false ? 'V' : '',
                p.currency || 'EUR',
                p.price_paid || '',
                p.cost_price || '',
                p.agent_commission || '',
                p.crm_id || '',
                p.phone || '',
                p.booking_ref || '',
                p.special_notes || ''
            ]);
            
            // Create workbook
            if (typeof XLSX === 'undefined') {
                const script = document.createElement('script');
                script.src = 'https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.0/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js';
                script.onload = () => createExcelFile(headers, rows);
                document.head.appendChild(script);
            } else {
                createExcelFile(headers, rows);
            }
        }
        
        function createExcelFile(headers, rows) {
            const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([headers, ...rows]);
            
            // Set column widths
            ws['!cols'] = [
                { wch: 5 },  // #
                { wch: 15 }, // First name
                { wch: 15 }, // Last name
                { wch: 15 }, // Agent
                { wch: 20 }, // Hotel
                { wch: 12 }, // Hotel code
                { wch: 15 }, // Room group
                { wch: 6 },  // Outbound
                { wch: 6 },  // Return
                { wch: 6 },  // Currency
                { wch: 10 }, // Price
                { wch: 10 }, // Cost
                { wch: 10 }, // Commission
                { wch: 15 }, // CRM ID
                { wch: 15 }, // Phone
                { wch: 18 }, // Booking ref
                { wch: 30 }  // Notes
            ];
            
            const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
            XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'נוסעים');
            
            // Generate filename
            const dest = flight?.destination_name || 'טיסה';
            const date = flight?.departure_date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            const filename = `נוסעים_${dest}_${date}.xlsx`;
            
            XLSX.writeFile(wb, filename);
            showToast('הקובץ יורד', 'success');
        }
        
        function exportToPDF() {
            document.getElementById('exportMenu').classList.remove('show');
            
            const activePassengers = passengers.filter(p => p.status === 'active' || !p.status);
            
            if (activePassengers.length === 0) {
                showToast('אין נוסעים לייצוא', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            // Create printable HTML
            const dest = flight?.destination_name || '';
            const dates = flight ? `${flight.departure_date} - ${flight.return_date}` : '';
            const airline = flight?.airline || '';
            
            const printContent = `
                <!DOCTYPE html>
                <html dir="rtl" lang="he">
                <head>
                    <meta charset="UTF-8">
                    <title>רשימת נוסעים - ${dest}</title>
                    <style>
                        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Heebo:wght@400;600;700&display=swap');
                        body { font-family: 'Heebo', sans-serif; padding: 20px; direction: rtl; }
                        h1 { color: #1a365d; margin-bottom: 5px; }
                        .subtitle { color: #666; margin-bottom: 20px; }
                        table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; font-size: 11px; }
                        th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; text-align: right; }
                        th { background: #1a365d; color: white; }
                        tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f9f9f9; }
                        .summary { margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: #f5f5f5; border-radius: 8px; }
                        .v-mark { color: #28a745; font-weight: bold; }
                        @media print { body { padding: 0; } }
                    </style>
                </head>
                <body>
                    <h1>רשימת נוסעים - ${escapeHtml(dest)}</h1>
                    <p class="subtitle">${escapeHtml(dates)} | ${escapeHtml(airline)} | סה"כ ${activePassengers.length} נוסעים</p>
                    
                    <table>
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th>#</th>
                                <th>שם פרטי</th>
                                <th>שם משפחה</th>
                                <th>סוכן</th>
                                <th>מלון</th>
                                <th>הלוך</th>
                                <th>חזור</th>
                                <th>מחיר</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            ${activePassengers.map((p, i) => `
                                <tr>
                                    <td>${i + 1}</td>
                                    <td>${escapeHtml(p.first_name || '')}</td>
                                    <td>${escapeHtml(p.last_name || '')}</td>
                                    <td>${escapeHtml(p.agent_name || '-')}</td>
                                    <td>${escapeHtml(p.hotel_name || '-')}</td>
                                    <td class="v-mark">${p.has_outbound !== false ? 'V' : '-'}</td>
                                    <td class="v-mark">${p.has_return !== false ? 'V' : '-'}</td>
                                    <td>${p.price_paid ? formatCurrency(p.price_paid, p.currency) : '-'}</td>
                                </tr>
                            `).join('')}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                    
                    <div class="summary">
                        <strong>סיכום:</strong> ${activePassengers.length} נוסעים | 
                        ${activePassengers.filter(p => p.has_outbound !== false).length} הלוך | 
                        ${activePassengers.filter(p => p.has_return !== false).length} חזור
                    </div>
                </body>
                </html>
            `;
            
            // Open in new window for print/save as PDF
            const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank');
            printWindow.document.write(printContent);
            printWindow.document.close();
            
            // Trigger print dialog (user can save as PDF)
            setTimeout(() => {
                printWindow.print();
            }, 500);
            
            showToast('חלון הדפסה נפתח - בחר "שמור כ-PDF"', 'success');
        }
        
        function printPassengers() {
            document.getElementById('exportMenu').classList.remove('show');
            window.print();
        }
    </script>

```sql
-- Lord Tickets - Phase 1: Passenger Management System
-- Migration 005: Create passengers, customers, and users tables

-- ============================================
-- CUSTOMERS TABLE (Master customer data)
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE customers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    crm_id TEXT,
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_customers_name ON customers(last_name, first_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_customers_crm_id ON customers(crm_id) WHERE crm_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_customers_phone ON customers(phone) WHERE phone IS NOT NULL;

-- ============================================
-- USERS TABLE (For role-based access)
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    auth_id UUID UNIQUE,
    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent' CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'manager', 'agent')),
    commission_rate DECIMAL(5, 2) DEFAULT 0,
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);
CREATE INDEX idx_users_role ON users(role);
CREATE INDEX idx_users_active ON users(is_active) WHERE is_active = true;

-- ============================================
-- ROOM GROUPS TABLE (For room sharing)
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE room_groups (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    flight_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES flights(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    room_type TEXT DEFAULT 'double' CHECK (room_type IN ('single', 'double', 'triple', 'family')),
    hotel_name TEXT,
    room_number INTEGER,
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_room_groups_flight ON room_groups(flight_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_room_groups_name ON room_groups(flight_id, name);

-- ============================================
-- PASSENGERS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE passengers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    flight_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES flights(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    customer_id UUID REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    agent_id UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT,
    crm_id TEXT,
    agent_name TEXT,
    has_outbound BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    has_return BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    hotel_name TEXT,
    hotel_booking_ref TEXT,
    room_group_id UUID REFERENCES room_groups(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    is_single_supplement BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    ticket_category TEXT,
    components JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'EUR' CHECK (currency IN ('EUR', 'USD', 'ILS', 'GBP')),
    price_paid DECIMAL(10, 2),
    cost_price DECIMAL(10, 2),
    agent_commission DECIMAL(10, 2),
    booking_ref TEXT,
    insurance_notes TEXT,
    special_notes TEXT,
    source TEXT DEFAULT 'manual' CHECK (source IN ('manual', 'excel_import', 'copy_paste', 'migration')),
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'waitlist')),
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    cancelled_reason TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_passengers_flight ON passengers(flight_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_passengers_customer ON passengers(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_passengers_agent ON passengers(agent_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_passengers_status ON passengers(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_passengers_name ON passengers(last_name, first_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_passengers_active ON passengers(flight_id, status) WHERE status = 'active';

-- ============================================
-- UPDATE FLIGHTS TABLE (Add new columns)
-- ============================================
ALTER TABLE flights ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS outbound_seats_total INTEGER;
ALTER TABLE flights ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS outbound_seats_available INTEGER;
ALTER TABLE flights ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS return_seats_total INTEGER;
ALTER TABLE flights ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS return_seats_available INTEGER;
ALTER TABLE flights ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS event_name TEXT;
ALTER TABLE flights ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS flight_code TEXT;

-- ============================================
-- TRIGGERS FOR UPDATED_AT
-- ============================================
CREATE TRIGGER customers_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON customers
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

CREATE TRIGGER users_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON users
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

CREATE TRIGGER passengers_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON passengers
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

-- ============================================
-- FUNCTION: Count passengers per flight leg
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_flight_passenger_counts(p_flight_id UUID)
RETURNS TABLE (
    total_passengers INTEGER,
    outbound_passengers INTEGER,
    return_passengers INTEGER,
    active_passengers INTEGER,
    cancelled_passengers INTEGER,
    waitlist_passengers INTEGER
) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER as total_passengers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_outbound = true AND status = 'active')::INTEGER as outbound_passengers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_return = true AND status = 'active')::INTEGER as return_passengers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active')::INTEGER as active_passengers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled')::INTEGER as cancelled_passengers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'waitlist')::INTEGER as waitlist_passengers
    FROM passengers
    WHERE flight_id = p_flight_id;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- ============================================
-- RLS POLICIES (Row Level Security)
-- ============================================
ALTER TABLE customers ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE passengers ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE room_groups ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY customers_select ON customers FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY users_select ON users FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY passengers_select ON passengers FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_select ON room_groups FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

CREATE POLICY customers_insert ON customers FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY users_insert ON users FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY passengers_insert ON passengers FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_insert ON room_groups FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE POLICY customers_update ON customers FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY users_update ON users FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY passengers_update ON passengers FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_update ON room_groups FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true);

CREATE POLICY customers_delete ON customers FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY users_delete ON users FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY passengers_delete ON passengers FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_delete ON room_groups FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);

COMMENT ON TABLE customers IS 'Master customer database with trip history';
COMMENT ON TABLE users IS 'System users with role-based access (admin, manager, agent)';
COMMENT ON TABLE passengers IS 'Individual passenger records per flight - replaces bookings table';
COMMENT ON TABLE room_groups IS 'Groups passengers sharing hotel rooms';
```

**Steps:**
1. Go to Supabase Dashboard → **SQL Editor** → **New Query**
2. Select all the SQL above (Ctrl+A in the code block)
3. Paste into the SQL Editor
4. Click **Run**

## Files to Modify

### 1. [login.html](login.html) - Store user role after login

After successful authentication, look up the user in the `users` table and store their role:

```javascript
// After auth success, lookup user role
const userResponse = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/users?auth_id=eq.${session.user.id}`);
const userData = await userResponse.json();
localStorage.setItem('userRole', userData[0]?.role || 'agent');
localStorage.setItem('userName', userData[0]?.name || email);
localStorage.setItem('userId', userData[0]?.id);
```

### 2. [flight-detail.html](flight-detail.html) - UI restrictions

**On page load**, read the role and apply restrictions:

```javascript
const userRole = localStorage.getItem('userRole') || 'agent';
const userId = localStorage.getItem('userId');

if (userRole === 'agent') {
    // Hide financial summary
    document.getElementById('financialSummary').style.display = 'none';
    // Hide export dropdown
    document.querySelector('.export-dropdown').style.display = 'none';
    // Hide delete buttons (handled in renderPassengers)
}
```

**In renderPassengerRow()**, conditionally show delete button:

```javascript
${(userRole !== 'agent') ? `
    <button class="action-btn delete" onclick="deletePassenger('${p.id}')">
        <span class="material-icons">delete</span>
    </button>
` : ''}
```

**In loadFlightData()**, filter passengers for agents:

```javascript
// For agents, only load their own passengers
let url = `${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/passengers?flight_id=eq.${flightId}`;
if (userRole === 'agent' && userId) {
    url += `&agent_id=eq.${userId}`;
}
```

### 3. [supabase/migrations/006_rls_roles.sql](supabase/migrations/006_rls_roles.sql) - Backend enforcement

Create new RLS policies that enforce role-based access:

```sql
-- Drop existing permissive policies
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_select ON passengers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_delete ON passengers;

-- Agents can only see their own passengers
CREATE POLICY passengers_select ON passengers FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM users 
        WHERE auth_id = auth.uid() 
        AND (role IN ('admin', 'manager') OR passengers.agent_id = users.id)
    )
);

-- Only admin/manager can delete
CREATE POLICY passengers_delete ON passengers FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM users 
        WHERE auth_id = auth.uid() 
        AND role IN ('admin', 'manager')
    )
);
```

### 4. Hide cost fields in passenger form for agents

In the passenger form, hide cost_price and agent_commission fields:

```javascript
if (userRole === 'agent') {

}
```

```javascript
function displayCurrentUser() {
    const name = localStorage.getItem('userName') || 'אורח';
    const role = localStorage.getItem('userRole') || 'demo';
    const roleLabels = { admin: 'מנהל', manager: 'מנהל צוות', agent: 'סוכן', demo: 'מצב הדגמה' };
    document.getElementById('userDisplay').textContent = `שלום, ${name} (${roleLabels[role]})`;
}

function logout() {
    localStorage.removeItem('userSession');
    localStorage.removeItem('userRole');
    localStorage.removeItem('userName');
    localStorage.removeItem('userId');
    window.location.href = 'login.html';
}
```

# Lord Tickets Platform - Enterprise Vision

## Product Vision

Transform from a single-company tool into a **SaaS platform** where multiple travel agencies can manage their flight packages, with customer self-service and intelligent automation.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Platform [Lord Tickets Platform]
        Auth[Authentication]
        Core[Core Engine]
        Docs[Document Generator]
        Analytics[Analytics Engine]
        Notify[Notification Service]
    end
    
    subgraph Agencies [Travel Agencies]
        A1[Agency 1]
        A2[Agency 2]
        A3[Agency N...]
    end
    
    subgraph Customers [Customer Portal]
        C1[View Bookings]
        C2[Download Docs]
        C3[Payment Status]
    end
    
    subgraph Integrations [External Services]
        WA[WhatsApp API]
        GC[Google Calendar]
        PDF[PDF Generation]
    end
    
    A1 & A2 & A3 --> Auth
    Auth --> Core
    Core --> Docs & Analytics & Notify
    Notify --> WA
    Core --> GC
    Docs --> PDF
    Customers --> Core
```

**Duration: 1 sprint | Priority: CRITICAL**

The foundation that enables everything else.

```sql
-- Already have users table with roles
-- Add organization_id for future multi-tenancy
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN organization_id UUID;
ALTER TABLE flights ADD COLUMN organization_id UUID;
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD COLUMN organization_id UUID;
```

| Manage users | Yes | No | No |

## PHASE 2: Multi-Tenancy (SaaS Architecture)
**Duration: 2 sprints | Priority: HIGH**

Enable multiple travel agencies on the same platform.

### Architecture
```mermaid
erDiagram
    ORGANIZATIONS ||--o{ USERS : has
    ORGANIZATIONS ||--o{ FLIGHTS : owns
    ORGANIZATIONS ||--o{ PASSENGERS : owns
    ORGANIZATIONS ||--o{ CUSTOMERS : owns
    ORGANIZATIONS {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        string subdomain
        string logo_url
        jsonb settings
        string plan
    }
    USERS {
        uuid id PK
        uuid organization_id FK
        string role
    }
```

### Features
- **Organization isolation** - Each agency sees only their data
- **Custom subdomain** - agency1.lordtickets.com
- **White-label branding** - Custom logo, colors
- **Plan tiers** - Free, Pro, Enterprise
- **Super-admin role** - Platform owner can manage all agencies

### Database Migration
```sql
CREATE TABLE organizations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    subdomain TEXT UNIQUE,
    logo_url TEXT,
    primary_color TEXT DEFAULT '#1a365d',
    plan TEXT DEFAULT 'free' CHECK (plan IN ('free', 'pro', 'enterprise')),
    settings JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Add org_id to all tables
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id);
ALTER TABLE flights ADD COLUMN organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id);
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD COLUMN organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id);
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id);

-- RLS: Users can only see their organization's data
CREATE POLICY org_isolation ON passengers FOR ALL USING (
    organization_id = (SELECT organization_id FROM users WHERE auth_id = auth.uid())
);
```

# Lord Tickets - Single Agency Build

**Build for yourself first, perfect it, then scale to SaaS.**

```
NOW:    Single agency (your company)
LATER:  Multi-tenant SaaS (sell to other agencies)
```

| Phase | Feature | Why This Order |
|-------|---------|----------------|
| 1 | Roles + Navigation | Foundation - need this for everything |
| 2 | Auto Documents | Saves the MOST time daily |
| 3 | Customer Portal | Reduces support calls |
| 4 | Analytics | Business insights |
| 5 | Calendar | Quality of life |
| 6 | WhatsApp | Requires API setup time |

# Phase 1 Design Specification

## 1. Top Navigation Bar (All Pages)

A consistent header across the app.

```
[Logo] Lord Tickets                                        [User: Name (Role)] [Logout]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[Flight Inventory]   [Users (Admin Only)]   [Reports (Manager/Admin)]
```

**Design:**
- Dark blue background (`#1a365d`)
- White text
- Active tab highlighted in gold (`#d4af37`)
- User info on the right with a small logout icon

## 2. User Management Page (Admin Only)

A clean table to manage staff.

**Header:**
- Title: "Staff Management"
- Button: "+ Add New User"

**Table Columns:**
1. **Name** (e.g., "David Cohen")
2. **Email** (e.g., "david@lordtickets.com")
3. **Role** (Badge: Admin=Red, Manager=Blue, Agent=Green)
4. **Commission** (e.g., "10%")
5. **Status** (Active/Inactive toggle)
6. **Actions** (Edit icon)

**Add User Modal:**
- Name
- Email
- Password (for Supabase Auth)
- Role (Dropdown: Admin, Manager, Agent)
- Commission Rate (%)

## 3. Flight Detail Page (Role Changes)

How the page looks differently for each role:

**For Admins/Managers:**
- **Full View:** See everything as it is now.
- **Financial Panel:** Visible (Revenue, Cost, Profit).
- **Delete Buttons:** Visible (Red trash icon).
- **Export Menu:** Visible.

**For Agents:**
- **Limited View:** Only see passengers *they* created (or assigned to them).
- **Financial Panel:** **HIDDEN** (They only see passenger count).
- **Delete Buttons:** **HIDDEN** (They can only "Cancel" via status change, not permanently delete).
- **Cost Fields:** **HIDDEN** in the Add/Edit form.
- **Export Menu:** **HIDDEN**.

## 4. Setup Wizard (First Run)

A simple, one-time page if no users exist.

**Center Card:**
- Title: "Welcome to Lord Tickets"
- Subtitle: "Create your Admin Account"
- Fields:
  - Supabase URL (if not set)
  - Supabase Key (if not set)
  - Admin Email
  - Admin Password
  - Admin Name
- Button: "Complete Setup"

## 5. Agent Assignment (Add Passenger Modal)

When adding a passenger:

**If Admin/Manager:**
- **Agent Field:** Becomes a **Dropdown** list of all active agents.
- Default: Selects the current user, but can be changed.

**If Agent:**
- **Agent Field:** Auto-filled with their name and **Disabled** (readonly).

Got it. Let me confirm the final design based on your choices:

1. **Passenger Visibility**: **Strict (Own Only)**. Agents log in and *only* see passengers assigned to them. They have no idea who else is on the flight.
   - *Impact*: Cleaner view for agents, maximum privacy/security.

2. **Manager & Users**: You said "they can do it" - so **Managers can manage users too**.
   - *Impact*: Managers will have access to the `users.html` page to add/edit agents.

3. **Cancellation**: **Request Only**.
   - *Impact*: We need a new status: `cancellation_requested`.
   - Agents click "Request Cancel".
   - Status becomes `cancellation_requested` (yellow).
   - Manager/Admin sees pending request and clicks "Approve Cancel" (turns to `cancelled` red) or "Reject".

4. **Financials**: **Partial**.
   - Agents see `price_paid` (Sale Price).
   - Agents **DO NOT** see `cost_price`, `agent_commission`, or the Financial Summary panel (Total Revenue/Profit).

## Phase 1.1: Database Update

Creating migration to add `cancellation_requested` status.
[Tool call] Write
  path: c:\Users\shake\lord-tickets-app\supabase\migrations\006_rls_roles.sql
  contents: -- Lord Tickets - Phase 1: Role-Based Access Control
-- Migration 006: Update status enum and RLS policies

-- ============================================
-- UPDATE STATUS CONSTRAINT (Add cancellation_requested)
-- ============================================
ALTER TABLE passengers DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS passengers_status_check;
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD CONSTRAINT passengers_status_check 
    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'waitlist', 'cancellation_requested'));

-- Add column for cancellation request details
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancellation_requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancellation_requested_by UUID REFERENCES users(id);
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancellation_request_reason TEXT;

-- ============================================
-- DROP EXISTING PERMISSIVE POLICIES
-- ============================================
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_select ON passengers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_insert ON passengers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_update ON passengers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_delete ON passengers;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS customers_select ON customers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS customers_insert ON customers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS customers_update ON customers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS customers_delete ON customers;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_select ON users;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_insert ON users;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_update ON users;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_delete ON users;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS room_groups_select ON room_groups;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS room_groups_insert ON room_groups;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS room_groups_update ON room_groups;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS room_groups_delete ON room_groups;

-- ============================================
-- HELPER FUNCTION: Get current user's role
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_role()
RETURNS TEXT AS $$
DECLARE
    user_role TEXT;
BEGIN
    SELECT role INTO user_role 
    FROM users 
    WHERE auth_id = auth.uid();
    
    RETURN COALESCE(user_role, 'agent');
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- ============================================
-- HELPER FUNCTION: Get current user's ID
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_id()
RETURNS UUID AS $$
DECLARE
    user_uuid UUID;
BEGIN
    SELECT id INTO user_uuid 
    FROM users 
    WHERE auth_id = auth.uid();
    
    RETURN user_uuid;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- ============================================
-- PASSENGERS POLICIES
-- ============================================

-- SELECT: Admins/Managers see all, Agents see only their own
CREATE POLICY passengers_select ON passengers FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
    OR agent_id = get_user_id()
    OR created_by = get_user_id()
);

-- INSERT: All authenticated users can insert
CREATE POLICY passengers_insert ON passengers FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (true);

-- UPDATE: Admins/Managers can update all, Agents only their own
CREATE POLICY passengers_update ON passengers FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
    OR agent_id = get_user_id()
    OR created_by = get_user_id()
);

-- DELETE: Only Admins and Managers can hard delete
CREATE POLICY passengers_delete ON passengers FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

-- ============================================
-- USERS POLICIES
-- ============================================

-- SELECT: All authenticated users can see users list (for dropdowns)
CREATE POLICY users_select ON users FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (true);

-- INSERT: Only Admins and Managers can add users
CREATE POLICY users_insert ON users FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

-- UPDATE: Only Admins and Managers can update users
CREATE POLICY users_update ON users FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

-- DELETE: Only Admins can delete users
CREATE POLICY users_delete ON users FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() = 'admin'
);

-- ============================================
-- CUSTOMERS POLICIES (All authenticated can CRUD)
-- ============================================
CREATE POLICY customers_select ON customers FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY customers_insert ON customers FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY customers_update ON customers FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY customers_delete ON customers FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);

-- ============================================
-- ROOM_GROUPS POLICIES (All authenticated can CRUD)
-- ============================================
CREATE POLICY room_groups_select ON room_groups FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_insert ON room_groups FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_update ON room_groups FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_delete ON room_groups FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);

-- ============================================
-- FLIGHTS POLICIES
-- ============================================
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS flights_select ON flights;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS flights_insert ON flights;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS flights_update ON flights;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS flights_delete ON flights;

-- SELECT: All can view flights
CREATE POLICY flights_select ON flights FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

-- INSERT: Only Admins and Managers can add flights
CREATE POLICY flights_insert ON flights FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

-- UPDATE: Only Admins and Managers can update flights
CREATE POLICY flights_update ON flights FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

-- DELETE: Only Admins and Managers can delete flights
CREATE POLICY flights_delete ON flights FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

-- ============================================
-- COMMENTS
-- ============================================
COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_user_role() IS 'Returns the role of the currently authenticated user';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_user_id() IS 'Returns the users table ID of the currently authenticated user';
COMMENT ON COLUMN passengers.cancellation_requested_at IS 'Timestamp when agent requested cancellation';
COMMENT ON COLUMN passengers.cancellation_requested_by IS 'User ID of agent who requested cancellation';
COMMENT ON COLUMN passengers.cancellation_request_reason IS 'Reason provided by agent for cancellation request';

    // Helper function to escape HTML
    function escapeHtml(text) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.textContent = text;

    function checkAuth() {
        const session = localStorage.getItem('userSession');
        if (!session) {
            window.location.href = 'login.html';
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    // Get current user role
    function getRole() {
        return localStorage.getItem('userRole') || 'agent';
    }
    
    // Check if user has specific role(s)
    function hasRole(...roles) {
        const userRole = getRole();
        return roles.includes(userRole);
    }
    
    // Check if user can perform action
    function canManageUsers() {
        return hasRole('admin', 'manager');
    }
    
    function canDeletePassengers() {
        return hasRole('admin', 'manager');
    }
    
    function canSeeCosts() {
        return hasRole('admin', 'manager');
    }
    
    function canExportData() {
        return hasRole('admin', 'manager');
    }
    
    function canManageFlights() {
        return hasRole('admin', 'manager');
    }
    
    // Expose to global scope
    window.LordNav = {

  new_string:         function renderPassengerRow(p, index, isCancelledView, isGrouped = false) {
            const userRole = localStorage.getItem('userRole') || 'agent';
            const canDelete = userRole === 'admin' || userRole === 'manager';

            const isPendingCancel = p.status === 'cancellation_requested';
            
            // Status badge for cancellation requested
            let statusBadge = '';

                    `;

        // ==========================================
        // Cancellation Request Functions (Agent Flow)

        async function requestCancellation(id) {
            const passenger = passengers.find(p => p.id === id);
            if (!passenger) return;
            
            const reason = prompt(`בקשת ביטול עבור ${passenger.first_name} ${passenger.last_name}\n\nנא לציין סיבה לביטול:`);
            if (!reason) return;  // User cancelled the prompt
            
            showLoading(true);
            
            try {
                const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
                const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
                const userId = localStorage.getItem('userId');
                
                const updateData = {
                    status: 'cancellation_requested',
                    cancellation_requested_at: new Date().toISOString(),
                    cancellation_requested_by: userId || null,
                    cancellation_request_reason: reason
                };
                
                if (supabaseUrl && supabaseKey) {
                    const response = await fetch(
                        `${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/passengers?id=eq.${id}`,
                        {
                            method: 'PATCH',
                            headers: {
                                'apikey': supabaseKey,
                                'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`,
                                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                            },
                            body: JSON.stringify(updateData)
                        }
                    );
                    
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to request cancellation');
                    await loadFlightData();
                } else {
                    // Demo mode
                    const index = passengers.findIndex(p => p.id === id);
                    if (index >= 0) {
                        passengers[index] = { ...passengers[index], ...updateData };
                    }
                    updateStats();
                    filterPassengers();
                }
                
                showToast('בקשת הביטול נשלחה למנהל', 'success');
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error requesting cancellation:', error);
                showToast('שגיאה בשליחת בקשת ביטול', 'error');
            } finally {
                showLoading(false);
            }
        }
        
        async function approveCancellation(id) {
            if (!confirm('לאשר את בקשת הביטול?')) return;
            
            showLoading(true);

    <script>
        let users = [];
        let editingUserId = null;
        
        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Initialize navigation
            if (typeof LordNav !== 'undefined') {
                LordNav.init('users');
                
                // Check if user can access this page
                if (!LordNav.canManageUsers()) {
                    showToast('אין לך הרשאה לצפות בדף זה', 'error');
                    setTimeout(() => window.location.href = 'inventory.html', 2000);
                    return;
                }
            }
            
            loadUsers();
        });
        
        async function loadUsers() {
            try {
                const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
                const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
                
                if (supabaseUrl && supabaseKey) {
                    const response = await fetch(
                        `${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/users?select=*&order=name.asc`,
                        {
                            headers: {
                                'apikey': supabaseKey,
                                'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`
                            }
                        }
                    );
                    
                    if (response.ok) {
                        users = await response.json();
                    } else {
                        users = [];
                    }
                } else {
                    // Demo mode
                    users = [
                        { id: '1', name: 'Admin User', email: 'admin@lord.com', role: 'admin', commission_rate: 0, is_active: true },
                        { id: '2', name: 'Manager User', email: 'manager@lord.com', role: 'manager', commission_rate: 5, is_active: true },
                        { id: '3', name: 'Agent User', email: 'agent@lord.com', role: 'agent', commission_rate: 10, is_active: true }
                    ];
                }
                
                renderUsers();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error loading users:', error);
                showToast('שגיאה בטעינת משתמשים', 'error');
            }
        }
        
        function renderUsers() {
            const table = document.getElementById('usersTable');
            const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
            
            if (users.length === 0) {
                table.innerHTML = '';
                emptyState.style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('usersCount').textContent = '0 משתמשים';
                return;
            }
            
            emptyState.style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('usersCount').textContent = `${users.length} משתמשים`;
            
            const roleLabels = {
                admin: 'מנהל ראשי',
                manager: 'מנהל צוות',
                agent: 'סוכן'
            };
            
            table.innerHTML = users.map(user => `
                <tr>
                    <td><strong>${escapeHtml(user.name)}</strong></td>
                    <td style="direction: ltr; text-align: right;">${escapeHtml(user.email)}</td>
                    <td><span class="role-badge ${user.role}">${roleLabels[user.role] || user.role}</span></td>
                    <td>${user.commission_rate ? user.commission_rate + '%' : '-'}</td>
                    <td>
                        <label class="status-toggle">
                            <input type="checkbox" ${user.is_active ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleUserStatus('${user.id}', this.checked)">
                            <span class="status-slider"></span>
                        </label>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        <div class="actions-cell">
                            <button class="action-btn" onclick="editUser('${user.id}')" title="ערוך">
                                <span class="material-icons">edit</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            `).join('');
        }
        
        function openAddModal() {
            editingUserId = null;
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = 'הוסף משתמש';
            document.getElementById('userForm').reset();
            document.getElementById('userModal').classList.add('show');
        }
        
        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('userModal').classList.remove('show');
        }
        
        function editUser(id) {
            const user = users.find(u => u.id === id);
            if (!user) return;
            
            editingUserId = id;
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = 'ערוך משתמש';
            document.getElementById('userName').value = user.name;
            document.getElementById('userEmail').value = user.email;
            document.getElementById('userRole').value = user.role;
            document.getElementById('userCommission').value = user.commission_rate || '';
            
            document.getElementById('userModal').classList.add('show');
        }
        
        async function saveUser(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            
            const userData = {
                name: document.getElementById('userName').value.trim(),
                email: document.getElementById('userEmail').value.trim(),
                role: document.getElementById('userRole').value,
                commission_rate: parseFloat(document.getElementById('userCommission').value) || 0
            };
            
            try {
                const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
                const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
                
                if (supabaseUrl && supabaseKey) {
                    let response;
                    
                    if (editingUserId) {
                        response = await fetch(
                            `${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/users?id=eq.${editingUserId}`,
                            {
                                method: 'PATCH',
                                headers: {
                                    'apikey': supabaseKey,
                                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`,
                                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                                },
                                body: JSON.stringify(userData)
                            }
                        );
                    } else {
                        userData.is_active = true;
                        response = await fetch(
                            `${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/users`,
                            {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: {
                                    'apikey': supabaseKey,
                                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`,
                                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                                },
                                body: JSON.stringify(userData)
                            }
                        );
                    }
                    
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to save user');
                    
                    await loadUsers();
                } else {
                    // Demo mode
                    if (editingUserId) {
                        const index = users.findIndex(u => u.id === editingUserId);
                        if (index >= 0) {
                            users[index] = { ...users[index], ...userData };
                        }
                    } else {
                        users.push({
                            id: Date.now().toString(),
                            ...userData,
                            is_active: true
                        });
                    }
                    renderUsers();
                }
                
                closeModal();
                showToast(editingUserId ? 'המשתמש עודכן בהצלחה' : 'המשתמש נוסף בהצלחה', 'success');
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error saving user:', error);
                showToast('שגיאה בשמירת משתמש', 'error');
            }
        }
        
        async function toggleUserStatus(id, isActive) {
            try {
                const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
                const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
                
                if (supabaseUrl && supabaseKey) {
                    const response = await fetch(
                        `${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/users?id=eq.${id}`,
                        {
                            method: 'PATCH',
                            headers: {
                                'apikey': supabaseKey,
                                'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`,
                                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                            },
                            body: JSON.stringify({ is_active: isActive })
                        }
                    );
                    
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to update status');
                } else {
                    // Demo mode
                    const index = users.findIndex(u => u.id === id);
                    if (index >= 0) {
                        users[index].is_active = isActive;
                    }
                }
                
                showToast(isActive ? 'המשתמש הופעל' : 'המשתמש הושבת', 'success');
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error toggling status:', error);
                showToast('שגיאה בעדכון סטטוס', 'error');
                loadUsers();  // Reload to revert UI
            }
        }
        
        function escapeHtml(text) {
            if (!text) return '';
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = text;
            return div.innerHTML;
        }
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            toast.textContent = message;
            toast.className = `toast ${type} show`;
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.remove('show');
            }, 3000);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        let currentStep = 1;
        
        // Check on load if setup is already done
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
            // Load saved settings
            const savedUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
            const savedKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
            
            if (savedUrl) document.getElementById('supabaseUrl').value = savedUrl;
            if (savedKey) document.getElementById('supabaseKey').value = savedKey;
            
            // Check if users already exist
            if (savedUrl && savedKey) {
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(`${savedUrl}/rest/v1/users?limit=1`, {
                        headers: {
                            'apikey': savedKey,
                            'Authorization': `Bearer ${savedKey}`
                        }
                    });
                    
                    if (response.ok) {
                        const users = await response.json();
                        if (users.length > 0) {
                            // Setup already done, redirect to login
                            window.location.href = 'login.html';
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log('Cannot check users, showing setup');
                }
            }
        });
        
        function showError(message) {
            const el = document.getElementById('errorMessage');
            el.textContent = message;
            el.classList.add('show');
        }
        
        function hideError() {
            document.getElementById('errorMessage').classList.remove('show');
        }
        
        function goToStep(step) {
            // Hide all steps
            document.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.step-dot').forEach((d, i) => {
                d.classList.remove('active', 'done');
                if (i < step - 1) d.classList.add('done');
                if (i === step - 1) d.classList.add('active');
            });
            
            // Show target step
            document.getElementById(`step${step}`).classList.add('active');
            currentStep = step;
            hideError();
        }
        
        async function validateSupabase() {
            const url = document.getElementById('supabaseUrl').value.trim();
            const key = document.getElementById('supabaseKey').value.trim();
            
            if (!url || !key) {
                showError('נא להזין את כל הפרטים');
                return;
            }
            
            try {
                // Test connection by fetching flights
                const response = await fetch(`${url}/rest/v1/flights?limit=1`, {
                    headers: {
                        'apikey': key,
                        'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`
                    }
                });
                
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Connection failed');
                }
                
                // Save settings
                localStorage.setItem('supabaseUrl', url);
                localStorage.setItem('supabaseKey', key);
                
                goToStep(2);
                
            } catch (error) {
                showError('שגיאה בחיבור ל-Supabase. בדוק את הפרטים');
            }
        }
        
        async function createAdmin() {
            const name = document.getElementById('adminName').value.trim();
            const email = document.getElementById('adminEmail').value.trim();
            
            if (!name || !email) {
                showError('נא להזין שם ואימייל');
                return;
            }
            
            const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
            const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
            
            try {
                // Create admin user in users table
                const response = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/users`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'apikey': supabaseKey,
                        'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`,
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        name: name,
                        email: email,
                        role: 'admin',
                        is_active: true,
                        commission_rate: 0
                    })
                });
                
                if (!response.ok) {
                    const error = await response.text();
                    throw new Error(error);
                }
                
                goToStep(3);
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error creating admin:', error);
                showError('שגיאה ביצירת חשבון: ' + error.message);
            }
        }

- Agents click "Request Cancel" → enters reason

- Top nav bar on all pages

- Logout functionality

   - Paste in SQL Editor and Run

    function generateDocNumber(type) {
        const prefix = type === 'receipt' ? 'RCP' : type === 'invoice' ? 'INV' : 'LST';
        const date = new Date();
        const dateStr = `${date.getFullYear()}${(date.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0')}${date.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;
        const random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000).toString().padStart(3, '0');
        return `${prefix}-${dateStr}-${random}`;
    }
    
    // Format date in Hebrew style
    function formatDate(date) {
        if (!date) date = new Date();
        if (typeof date === 'string') date = new Date(date);
        return `${date.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0')}/${(date.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0')}/${date.getFullYear()}`;
    }

    // Generate Invoice HTML
    function generateInvoice(passengers, flight, options = {}) {
        const docNumber = options.docNumber || generateDocNumber('invoice');
        const date = options.date || new Date();
        
        // Calculate totals by currency
        const totals = {};
        passengers.forEach(p => {
            const currency = p.currency || 'EUR';
            if (!totals[currency]) totals[currency] = 0;
            totals[currency] += parseFloat(p.price_paid || 0);
        });
        
        const passengerRows = passengers.map((p, i) => `
            <tr>
                <td>${i + 1}</td>
                <td>${p.first_name} ${p.last_name}</td>
                <td>${p.has_outbound !== false ? '✓' : '-'}</td>
                <td>${p.has_return !== false ? '✓' : '-'}</td>
                <td>${p.hotel_name || '-'}</td>
                <td>${formatCurrency(p.price_paid, p.currency)}</td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
        
        const totalRows = Object.entries(totals).map(([currency, amount]) => `
            <tr class="total-row">
                <td colspan="5">${labels.total} (${currency})</td>
                <td>${formatCurrency(amount, currency)}</td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
        
        return `
            <!DOCTYPE html>
            <html lang="he" dir="rtl">
            <head>
                <meta charset="UTF-8">
                <title>חשבונית - ${flight.destination}</title>
                <style>${baseStyles}</style>
            </head>
            <body>
                <div class="watermark">${companyInfo.logo}</div>
                <div class="document">
                    <div class="header">
                        <div class="logo-section">
                            <div class="logo">${companyInfo.logo}</div>
                            <div class="company-name">${companyInfo.name}</div>
                            <div class="company-tagline">${companyInfo.tagline}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="doc-info">
                            <div class="doc-type">${labels.invoice}</div>
                            <div class="doc-number">${labels.documentNo}: ${docNumber}</div>
                            <div class="doc-date">${labels.date}: ${formatDate(date)}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="section">
                        <h3 class="section-title">${labels.flightDetails}</h3>
                        <div class="info-grid">
                            <div class="info-item">
                                <span class="info-label">${labels.destination}:</span>
                                <span class="info-value"><strong>${flight.destination || '-'}</strong></span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="info-item">
                                <span class="info-label">תאריכים:</span>
                                <span class="info-value">${formatDate(flight.departure_date)} - ${formatDate(flight.return_date)}</span>
                            </div>
                            ${flight.flight_code ? `
                            <div class="info-item">
                                <span class="info-label">קוד טיסה:</span>
                                <span class="info-value">${flight.flight_code}</span>
                            </div>` : ''}
                            <div class="info-item">
                                <span class="info-label">מספר נוסעים:</span>
                                <span class="info-value">${passengers.length}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="section">
                        <h3 class="section-title">רשימת נוסעים</h3>
                        <table>
                            <thead>
                                <tr>
                                    <th>#</th>
                                    <th>שם מלא</th>
                                    <th>הלוך</th>
                                    <th>חזור</th>
                                    <th>${labels.hotel}</th>
                                    <th>${labels.price}</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                ${passengerRows}
                                ${totalRows}
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="footer">
                        <div class="thank-you">${labels.thankYou}</div>
                        <div class="signature-section">
                            <div class="signature-box">
                                <div class="signature-line">אישור הלקוח</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="signature-box">
                                <div class="signature-line">חתימת ${companyInfo.name}</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="printed-date">${labels.printed}: ${formatDate(new Date())} ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL')}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <script>
                    window.onload = function() { window.print(); }
                </script>
            </body>
            </html>
        `;
    }

        return `

    // Generate Hotel List (grouped by hotel)
    function generateHotelList(passengers, flight, options = {}) {
        const docNumber = options.docNumber || generateDocNumber('list');
        
        // Group by hotel
        const hotels = {};
        passengers.forEach(p => {
            const hotelName = p.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון';
            if (!hotels[hotelName]) hotels[hotelName] = [];
            hotels[hotelName].push(p);
        });
        
        const hotelSections = Object.entries(hotels).map(([hotelName, guests]) => `
            <div class="hotel-section">
                <h4 style="background: #1a365d; color: white; padding: 10px 15px; margin: 20px 0 10px 0;">
                    🏨 ${hotelName} (${guests.length} אורחים)
                </h4>
                <table>
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th>#</th>
                            <th>שם מלא</th>
                            <th>טלפון</th>
                            <th>אישור מלון</th>
                            <th>חדר</th>
                            <th>הערות</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        ${guests.map((p, i) => `
                            <tr>
                                <td>${i + 1}</td>
                                <td><strong>${p.first_name} ${p.last_name}</strong></td>
                                <td>${p.phone || '-'}</td>
                                <td>${p.hotel_booking_ref || '-'}</td>
                                <td>${p.room_group_name || '-'}</td>
                                <td>${p.special_notes || '-'}</td>
                            </tr>
                        `).join('')}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        `).join('');
        
        return `
            <!DOCTYPE html>
            <html lang="he" dir="rtl">
            <head>
                <meta charset="UTF-8">
                <title>רשימת מלונות - ${flight.destination}</title>
                <style>
                    ${baseStyles}
                    table { font-size: 12px; }
                    th, td { padding: 8px 12px; }
                </style>
            </head>
            <body>
                <div class="document">
                    <div class="header">
                        <div class="logo-section">
                            <div class="logo">${companyInfo.logo}</div>
                            <div class="company-name">${companyInfo.name}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="doc-info">
                            <div class="doc-type">רשימת מלונות</div>
                            <div class="doc-number">${labels.documentNo}: ${docNumber}</div>
                            <div class="doc-date">${labels.date}: ${formatDate()}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="section">
                        <div class="info-grid">
                            <div class="info-item">
                                <span class="info-label">${labels.destination}:</span>
                                <span class="info-value"><strong>${flight.destination}</strong></span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="info-item">
                                <span class="info-label">תאריכים:</span>
                                <span class="info-value">${formatDate(flight.departure_date)} - ${formatDate(flight.return_date)}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    ${hotelSections}
                    
                    <div class="footer">
                        <div class="printed-date">${labels.printed}: ${formatDate(new Date())} ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('he-IL')}</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <script>
                    window.onload = function() { window.print(); }
                </script>
            </body>
            </html>
        `;
    }
    
    // Open document in new window
    function openDocument(html) {
        const win = window.open('', '_blank');
        win.document.write(html);
        win.document.close();
    }
    
    // Print single passenger receipt
    function printReceipt(passenger, flight) {
        const html = generateReceipt(passenger, flight);
        openDocument(html);
    }
    
    // Print invoice for multiple passengers
    function printInvoice(passengers, flight) {
        const html = generateInvoice(passengers, flight);
        openDocument(html);
    }
    
    // Print passenger list
    function printPassengerList(passengers, flight) {
        const html = generatePassengerList(passengers, flight);
        openDocument(html);
    }
    
    // Print hotel list
    function printHotelList(passengers, flight) {
        const html = generateHotelList(passengers, flight);
        openDocument(html);
    }
    
    // Expose to global scope
    window.LordDocs = {
        generateReceipt,
        generateInvoice,
        generatePassengerList,
        generateHotelList,
        printReceipt,
        printInvoice,
        printPassengerList,
        printHotelList,
        openDocument,
        generateDocNumber,
        formatDate,
        formatCurrency
    };
})();

## Phase 2.4: Create Documents Table Migration
[Tool call] Write
  path: c:\Users\shake\lord-tickets-app\supabase\migrations\007_documents.sql
  contents: -- Lord Tickets - Phase 2: Documents Table
-- Migration 007: Track generated documents

-- ============================================
-- DOCUMENTS TABLE
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    
    -- Document identification
    doc_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    doc_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('receipt', 'invoice', 'passenger_list', 'hotel_list')),
    
    -- Relations
    flight_id UUID REFERENCES flights(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    passenger_id UUID REFERENCES passengers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,  -- For individual receipts
    
    -- Metadata
    title TEXT,
    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'EUR',
    total_amount DECIMAL(10,2),
    passenger_count INTEGER,
    
    -- Content snapshot (optional - for record keeping)
    content_snapshot JSONB,  -- Store passenger data at time of generation
    
    -- Audit
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    
    -- Notes
    notes TEXT
);

-- ============================================
-- INDEXES
-- ============================================
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_flight ON documents(flight_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_passenger ON documents(passenger_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_type ON documents(doc_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_created ON documents(created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_doc_number ON documents(doc_number);

-- ============================================
-- RLS POLICIES
-- ============================================
ALTER TABLE documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- All authenticated users can view documents
CREATE POLICY documents_select ON documents FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

-- All authenticated users can create documents
CREATE POLICY documents_insert ON documents FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);

-- Only admins/managers can delete documents
CREATE POLICY documents_delete ON documents FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM users 
        WHERE auth_id = auth.uid() 
        AND role IN ('admin', 'manager')
    )
);

-- ============================================
-- HELPER FUNCTION: Generate next document number
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_doc_number(p_type TEXT)
RETURNS TEXT AS $$
DECLARE
    prefix TEXT;
    date_part TEXT;
    seq_num INTEGER;
    new_number TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- Set prefix based on type
    CASE p_type
        WHEN 'receipt' THEN prefix := 'RCP';
        WHEN 'invoice' THEN prefix := 'INV';
        WHEN 'passenger_list' THEN prefix := 'LST';
        WHEN 'hotel_list' THEN prefix := 'HTL';
        ELSE prefix := 'DOC';
    END CASE;
    
    -- Date part
    date_part := TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD');
    
    -- Get next sequence number for today
    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(
        CAST(SUBSTRING(doc_number FROM LENGTH(prefix) + 10) AS INTEGER)
    ), 0) + 1
    INTO seq_num
    FROM documents
    WHERE doc_number LIKE prefix || '-' || date_part || '-%';
    
    -- Construct the number
    new_number := prefix || '-' || date_part || '-' || LPAD(seq_num::TEXT, 3, '0');
    
    RETURN new_number;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- ============================================
-- COMMENTS
-- ============================================
COMMENT ON TABLE documents IS 'Track all generated documents (receipts, invoices, lists)';
COMMENT ON COLUMN documents.doc_number IS 'Unique document number (e.g., RCP-20240115-001)';
COMMENT ON COLUMN documents.content_snapshot IS 'JSON snapshot of data at generation time for record keeping';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION generate_doc_number(TEXT) IS 'Generate sequential document numbers by type and date';

## Step-by-Step Instructions

### 1. Open Supabase SQL Editor
Go to: **https://supabase.com/dashboard** → Your Project → **SQL Editor** (left sidebar)

### 2. Copy and Run This SQL

Click "New query" and paste the **entire SQL below**, then click **Run**:

```sql
-- =============================================
-- PHASE 1 & 2 COMBINED MIGRATION
-- Lord Tickets - Run this in Supabase SQL Editor
-- =============================================

-- ============================================
-- PHASE 1: ROLE-BASED ACCESS CONTROL
-- ============================================

-- UPDATE STATUS CONSTRAINT (Add cancellation_requested)
ALTER TABLE passengers DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS passengers_status_check;
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD CONSTRAINT passengers_status_check 
    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'waitlist', 'cancellation_requested'));

-- Add column for cancellation request details
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancellation_requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancellation_requested_by UUID REFERENCES users(id);
ALTER TABLE passengers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cancellation_request_reason TEXT;

-- DROP EXISTING PERMISSIVE POLICIES
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_select ON passengers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_insert ON passengers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_update ON passengers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS passengers_delete ON passengers;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS customers_select ON customers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS customers_insert ON customers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS customers_update ON customers;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS customers_delete ON customers;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_select ON users;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_insert ON users;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_update ON users;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_delete ON users;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS room_groups_select ON room_groups;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS room_groups_insert ON room_groups;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS room_groups_update ON room_groups;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS room_groups_delete ON room_groups;

-- HELPER FUNCTION: Get current user's role
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_role()
RETURNS TEXT AS $$
DECLARE
    user_role TEXT;
BEGIN
    SELECT role INTO user_role 
    FROM users 
    WHERE auth_id = auth.uid();
    
    RETURN COALESCE(user_role, 'agent');
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- HELPER FUNCTION: Get current user's ID
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_id()
RETURNS UUID AS $$
DECLARE
    user_uuid UUID;
BEGIN
    SELECT id INTO user_uuid 
    FROM users 
    WHERE auth_id = auth.uid();
    
    RETURN user_uuid;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

-- PASSENGERS POLICIES
CREATE POLICY passengers_select ON passengers FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
    OR agent_id = get_user_id()
    OR created_by = get_user_id()
);

CREATE POLICY passengers_insert ON passengers FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE POLICY passengers_update ON passengers FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
    OR agent_id = get_user_id()
    OR created_by = get_user_id()
);

CREATE POLICY passengers_delete ON passengers FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

-- USERS POLICIES
CREATE POLICY users_select ON users FOR SELECT TO authenticated
USING (true);

CREATE POLICY users_insert ON users FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

CREATE POLICY users_update ON users FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

CREATE POLICY users_delete ON users FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() = 'admin'
);

-- CUSTOMERS POLICIES
CREATE POLICY customers_select ON customers FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY customers_insert ON customers FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY customers_update ON customers FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY customers_delete ON customers FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);

-- ROOM_GROUPS POLICIES
CREATE POLICY room_groups_select ON room_groups FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_insert ON room_groups FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_update ON room_groups FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY room_groups_delete ON room_groups FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);

-- FLIGHTS POLICIES
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS flights_select ON flights;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS flights_insert ON flights;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS flights_update ON flights;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS flights_delete ON flights;

CREATE POLICY flights_select ON flights FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

CREATE POLICY flights_insert ON flights FOR INSERT TO authenticated
WITH CHECK (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

CREATE POLICY flights_update ON flights FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

CREATE POLICY flights_delete ON flights FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    get_user_role() IN ('admin', 'manager')
);

-- ============================================
-- PHASE 2: DOCUMENTS TABLE
-- ============================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    doc_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    doc_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('receipt', 'invoice', 'passenger_list', 'hotel_list')),
    flight_id UUID REFERENCES flights(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    passenger_id UUID REFERENCES passengers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    title TEXT,
    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'EUR',
    total_amount DECIMAL(10,2),
    passenger_count INTEGER,
    content_snapshot JSONB,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    notes TEXT
);

-- INDEXES
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_flight ON documents(flight_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_passenger ON documents(passenger_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_type ON documents(doc_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_created ON documents(created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_documents_doc_number ON documents(doc_number);

-- RLS
ALTER TABLE documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY documents_select ON documents FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY documents_insert ON documents FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY documents_delete ON documents FOR DELETE TO authenticated
USING (
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM users 
        WHERE auth_id = auth.uid() 
        AND role IN ('admin', 'manager')
    )
);

-- HELPER FUNCTION: Generate document number
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_doc_number(p_type TEXT)
RETURNS TEXT AS $$
DECLARE
    prefix TEXT;
    date_part TEXT;
    seq_num INTEGER;
    new_number TEXT;
BEGIN
    CASE p_type
        WHEN 'receipt' THEN prefix := 'RCP';
        WHEN 'invoice' THEN prefix := 'INV';
        WHEN 'passenger_list' THEN prefix := 'LST';
        WHEN 'hotel_list' THEN prefix := 'HTL';
        ELSE prefix := 'DOC';
    END CASE;
    
    date_part := TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD');
    
    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(
        CAST(SUBSTRING(doc_number FROM LENGTH(prefix) + 10) AS INTEGER)
    ), 0) + 1
    INTO seq_num
    FROM documents
    WHERE doc_number LIKE prefix || '-' || date_part || '-%';
    
    new_number := prefix || '-' || date_part || '-' || LPAD(seq_num::TEXT, 3, '0');
    
    RETURN new_number;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
```
