    <script>
        // State
        let selectedReportType = null;
        let currentReportHtml = '';
        let flights = [];
        let agents = [];
        
        // Config
        const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
        const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
        const accessToken = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
        
        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
            if (typeof LordNav !== 'undefined') {
                LordNav.init('reports');
            }
            
            // Check auth
            if (!accessToken && !localStorage.getItem('demoMode')) {
                window.location.href = 'login.html';
                return;
            }
            
            // Check role - only admin/manager can view reports
            const role = localStorage.getItem('userRole') || 'agent';
            if (role === 'agent') {
                showToast('אין לך הרשאה לצפות בדוחות');
                setTimeout(() => window.location.href = 'inventory.html', 2000);
                return;
            }
            
            // Load data for dropdowns
            await Promise.all([loadFlights(), loadAgents()]);
            
            // Set default dates
            const today = new Date();
            const weekAgo = new Date(today);
            weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate() - 7);
            
            document.getElementById('endDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            document.getElementById('startDate').value = weekAgo.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            
            // Report card click handlers
            document.querySelectorAll('.report-card').forEach(card => {
                card.addEventListener('click', () => selectReportType(card.dataset.type));
            });
        });
        
        // Load flights for dropdown
        async function loadFlights() {
            if (!supabaseUrl) return;
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/flights?select=id,destination,departure_date&order=departure_date.desc&limit=50`, {
                    headers: {
                        'apikey': supabaseKey,
                        'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`
                    }
                });
                
                flights = await res.json();
                
                const select = document.getElementById('flightSelect');
                select.innerHTML = '<option value="">בחר טיסה...</option>';
                flights.forEach(f => {
                    const date = new Date(f.departure_date).toLocaleDateString('he-IL');
                    select.innerHTML += `<option value="${f.id}">${f.destination} - ${date}</option>`;
                });
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error loading flights:', err);
            }
        }
        
        // Load agents for dropdown
        async function loadAgents() {
            if (!supabaseUrl) return;
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/users?select=id,name,role&order=name`, {
                    headers: {
                        'apikey': supabaseKey,
                        'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`
                    }
                });
                
                agents = await res.json();
                
                const select = document.getElementById('agentSelect');
                select.innerHTML = '<option value="">בחר סוכן...</option>';
                agents.forEach(a => {
                    select.innerHTML += `<option value="${a.id}">${a.name}</option>`;
                });
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error loading agents:', err);
            }
        }
        
        // Select report type
        function selectReportType(type) {
            selectedReportType = type;
            
            // Update UI
            document.querySelectorAll('.report-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
            document.querySelector(`.report-card[data-type="${type}"]`).classList.add('selected');
            
            // Show options
            document.getElementById('reportOptions').classList.add('visible');
            
            // Show/hide specific fields
            const flightGroup = document.getElementById('flightSelectGroup');
            const agentGroup = document.getElementById('agentSelectGroup');
            const dateGroup = document.getElementById('dateRangeGroup');
            const dateGroup2 = document.getElementById('dateRangeGroup2');
            
            flightGroup.style.display = type === 'flight' ? 'flex' : 'none';
            agentGroup.style.display = type === 'agent' ? 'flex' : 'none';
            dateGroup.style.display = type !== 'flight' ? 'flex' : 'none';
            dateGroup2.style.display = type !== 'flight' ? 'flex' : 'none';
        }
        
        // Generate report
        async function generateReport() {
            if (!selectedReportType) {
                showToast('בחר סוג דו"ח');
                return;
            }
            
            const startDate = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
            const endDate = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
            const flightId = document.getElementById('flightSelect').value;
            const agentId = document.getElementById('agentSelect').value;
            
            // Validation
            if (selectedReportType === 'flight' && !flightId) {
                showToast('בחר טיסה');
                return;
            }
            
            if (selectedReportType === 'agent' && !agentId) {
                showToast('בחר סוכן');
                return;
            }
            
            // Generate report locally (since Edge Function needs deployment)
            await generateLocalReport(selectedReportType, { startDate, endDate, flightId, agentId });
        }
        
        // Generate report locally (fallback when Edge Function not deployed)
        async function generateLocalReport(type, options) {
            showToast('מייצר דו"ח...');
            
            try {
                let reportData = {};
                let html = '';
                
                switch (type) {
                    case 'daily':
                    case 'weekly':
                    case 'monthly':
                    case 'custom':
                        reportData = await fetchPeriodData(options.startDate, options.endDate);
                        html = generatePeriodHtml(reportData, type);
                        break;
                    
                    case 'flight':
                        reportData = await fetchFlightData(options.flightId);
                        html = generateFlightHtml(reportData);
                        break;
                    
                    case 'agent':
                        reportData = await fetchAgentData(options.agentId, options.startDate, options.endDate);
                        html = generateAgentHtml(reportData);
                        break;
                }
                
                currentReportHtml = html;
                showReportPreview(html, type);
                
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error generating report:', err);
                showToast('שגיאה ביצירת הדו"ח');
            }
        }
        
        // Fetch period data
        async function fetchPeriodData(startDate, endDate) {
            if (!supabaseUrl) return getDemoData();
            
            const [flightsRes, passengersRes] = await Promise.all([
                fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/flights?departure_date=gte.${startDate}&departure_date=lte.${endDate}`, {
                    headers: { 'apikey': supabaseKey, 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}` }
                }),
                fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/passengers?select=*,flights(destination)&created_at=gte.${startDate}&created_at=lte.${endDate}`, {
                    headers: { 'apikey': supabaseKey, 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}` }
                })
            ]);
            
            const flightsData = await flightsRes.json();
            const passengersData = await passengersRes.json();
            
            const activePassengers = passengersData.filter(p => p.status === 'active');
            const totalRevenue = activePassengers.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.selling_price || 0), 0);
            const totalCost = activePassengers.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.cost_price || 0), 0);
            
            const byDestination = {};
            passengersData.forEach(p => {
                const dest = p.flights?.destination || 'לא ידוע';
                byDestination[dest] = (byDestination[dest] || 0) + 1;
            });
            
            return {
                period: { start: startDate, end: endDate },
                summary: {
                    totalFlights: flightsData.length,
                    totalPassengers: passengersData.length,
                    activePassengers: activePassengers.length,
                    cancelledPassengers: passengersData.filter(p => p.status === 'cancelled').length,
                    totalRevenue,
                    totalCost,
                    totalProfit: totalRevenue - totalCost,
                    profitMargin: totalRevenue > 0 ? ((totalRevenue - totalCost) / totalRevenue * 100).toFixed(1) : 0
                },
                byDestination
            };
        }
        
        // Fetch flight data
        async function fetchFlightData(flightId) {
            if (!supabaseUrl) return getDemoFlightData();
            
            const [flightRes, passengersRes] = await Promise.all([
                fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/flights?id=eq.${flightId}`, {
                    headers: { 'apikey': supabaseKey, 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}` }
                }),
                fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/passengers?flight_id=eq.${flightId}&select=*,users!passengers_agent_id_fkey(name)`, {
                    headers: { 'apikey': supabaseKey, 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}` }
                })
            ]);
            
            const [flight] = await flightRes.json();
            const passengers = await passengersRes.json();
            
            const activePassengers = passengers.filter(p => p.status === 'active');
            const totalRevenue = activePassengers.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.selling_price || 0), 0);
            const totalCost = activePassengers.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.cost_price || 0), 0);
            
            return {
                flight,
                summary: {
                    totalSeats: flight?.total_seats || 0,
                    bookedSeats: activePassengers.length,
                    availableSeats: (flight?.total_seats || 0) - activePassengers.length,
                    occupancyRate: flight?.total_seats ? (activePassengers.length / flight.total_seats * 100).toFixed(1) : 0,
                    totalRevenue,
                    totalCost,
                    totalProfit: totalRevenue - totalCost
                },
                passengers
            };
        }
        
        // Fetch agent data
        async function fetchAgentData(agentId, startDate, endDate) {
            if (!supabaseUrl) return getDemoAgentData();
            
            const [agentRes, passengersRes] = await Promise.all([
                fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/users?id=eq.${agentId}`, {
                    headers: { 'apikey': supabaseKey, 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}` }
                }),
                fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/passengers?agent_id=eq.${agentId}&select=*,flights(destination,departure_date)&created_at=gte.${startDate}&created_at=lte.${endDate}`, {
                    headers: { 'apikey': supabaseKey, 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}` }
                })
            ]);
            
            const [agent] = await agentRes.json();
            const passengers = await passengersRes.json();
            
            const activePassengers = passengers.filter(p => p.status === 'active');
            const totalRevenue = activePassengers.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.selling_price || 0), 0);
            const commission = totalRevenue * (agent?.commission_rate || 0);
            
            return {
                agent,
                period: { start: startDate, end: endDate },
                summary: {
                    totalBookings: passengers.length,
                    activeBookings: activePassengers.length,
                    cancelledBookings: passengers.filter(p => p.status === 'cancelled').length,
                    totalRevenue,
                    commission
                },
                passengers
            };
        }

        // Show report preview
        function showReportPreview(html, type) {
            const typeLabels = { daily: 'דו"ח יומי', weekly: 'דו"ח שבועי', monthly: 'דו"ח חודשי', custom: 'דו"ח מותאם', flight: 'דו"ח טיסה', agent: 'דו"ח סוכן' };
            
            document.getElementById('previewTitle').textContent = typeLabels[type] || 'דו"ח';
            document.getElementById('reportPreview').classList.add('visible');
            
            const iframe = document.getElementById('reportFrame');
            iframe.srcdoc = html;
        }
        
        // Quick reports
        function generateQuickReport(period) {
            const today = new Date();
            let start, end;
            
            switch (period) {
                case 'today':
                    start = end = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    break;
                case 'yesterday':
                    const yesterday = new Date(today);
                    yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);
                    start = end = yesterday.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    break;
                case 'thisWeek':
                    const weekStart = new Date(today);
                    weekStart.setDate(weekStart.getDate() - today.getDay());
                    start = weekStart.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    end = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    break;
                case 'thisMonth':
                    start = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1).toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    end = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    break;
            }
            
            document.getElementById('startDate').value = start;

            generateLocalReport('custom', { startDate: start, endDate: end });
        }

        function printReport() {
            const iframe = document.getElementById('reportFrame');
            iframe.contentWindow.print();
        }
        
        // Download report
        function downloadReport() {
            const blob = new Blob([currentReportHtml], { type: 'text/html' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `report-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.html`;
            a.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            showToast('הדו"ח הורד בהצלחה');
        }
        
        // Email report
        function emailReport() {
            const email = prompt('הכנס כתובת מייל:');

                // In production, this would call the Edge Function
                showToast('שליחת מייל דורשת הפעלת Edge Function');
            }
        }

        function clearOptions() {
            selectedReportType = null;
            document.querySelectorAll('.report-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
            document.getElementById('reportOptions').classList.remove('visible');
            document.getElementById('reportPreview').classList.remove('visible');
        }
        
        // Toast
        function showToast(message) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            document.getElementById('toastMessage').textContent = message;
            toast.classList.add('visible');
            setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('visible'), 3000);
        }

## Overview

Build a packages system for flights (e.g., "Flight Only", "Flight + Hotel", "VIP Package") with automatic pricing, then enhance the Excel import to use these packages.

---

## Phase 1: Database Schema

Create new migration `supabase/migrations/008_packages.sql`:

```sql
CREATE TABLE flight_packages (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    flight_id UUID REFERENCES flights(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,                    -- e.g., "אפשרות א'", "טיסה בלבד"
    description TEXT,
    price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'ILS',           -- ILS, EUR, USD
    includes_flight_outbound BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    includes_flight_return BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    includes_hotel BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    includes_event_ticket BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    event_ticket_category TEXT,            -- e.g., "VIP", "Standard"
    max_quantity INTEGER,                  -- optional limit
    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Add package reference to passengers
ALTER TABLE passengers 
ADD COLUMN package_id UUID REFERENCES flight_packages(id);
```

---

## Phase 2: Package Management UI

Update [flight-detail.html](flight-detail.html):

- Add "Packages" tab/section in flight detail page
- Create/Edit/Delete packages for each flight
- Show package list with: Name, Price, Currency, Includes (icons)
- Quick-add common package templates

## Phase 3: Smart Excel Import

Update `parseExcel()` function in [flight-detail.html](flight-detail.html):

**Header Detection Algorithm:**
```javascript
function findHeaderRow(jsonData) {
    const knownHeaders = ['שם פרטי', 'שם משפחה', 'שם הסוכן', 'דוקט טופ', 'שם המלון'];
    let bestRow = 0, bestScore = 0;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(20, jsonData.length); i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i].map(cell => String(cell || '').trim());
        const score = row.filter(cell => 
            knownHeaders.some(h => cell.includes(h))
        ).length;
        if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; bestRow = i; }
    }
    return bestRow;
}
```

**New Column Mappings to Add:**
- `אפשרות א'` / `חבילה` / `package` -> package selection
- All existing Hebrew column names from your file

---

## Phase 4: Import with Package Selection

Update import wizard (Step 2 - Column Mapping):

- Detect if Excel has a "package" column (e.g., "אפשרות א'")
- If found: auto-map package values to flight packages
- If not found: show dropdown to assign all passengers to one package
- Preview shows calculated price per passenger

  path: c:\Users\shake\lord-tickets-app\supabase\migrations\008_packages.sql
  contents: -- Migration: Flight Packages System
-- Allows creating price packages per flight (e.g., "Flight Only", "Flight + Hotel", "VIP Package")

-- Create flight_packages table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS flight_packages (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    flight_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES flights(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,                              -- e.g., "אפשרות א'", "טיסה בלבד", "חבילת VIP"
    description TEXT,                                -- Optional description
    price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- Package price
    currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ILS',            -- ILS, EUR, USD
    includes_flight_outbound BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,   -- Includes outbound flight
    includes_flight_return BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,     -- Includes return flight
    includes_hotel BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,            -- Includes hotel
    hotel_nights INTEGER,                            -- Number of hotel nights if included
    includes_event_ticket BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,     -- Includes event/match ticket
    event_ticket_category TEXT,                      -- e.g., "VIP", "Standard", "Premium"
    includes_transport BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,        -- Includes ground transport
    includes_insurance BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,        -- Includes travel insurance
    max_quantity INTEGER,                            -- Optional max passengers for this package
    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,                    -- Display order
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,                  -- Can be disabled without deletion
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Add package reference to passengers table
ALTER TABLE passengers 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS package_id UUID REFERENCES flight_packages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- Add cost_price and selling_price if not exists (for price tracking)
ALTER TABLE passengers 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cost_price DECIMAL(10,2);

ALTER TABLE passengers 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS selling_price DECIMAL(10,2);

-- Create indexes for better query performance
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_flight_packages_flight_id ON flight_packages(flight_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_passengers_package_id ON passengers(package_id);

-- RLS Policies for flight_packages
ALTER TABLE flight_packages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Everyone can view packages (needed for booking)
CREATE POLICY flight_packages_select ON flight_packages
    FOR SELECT TO authenticated
    USING (true);

-- Only admin/manager can create packages
CREATE POLICY flight_packages_insert ON flight_packages
    FOR INSERT TO authenticated
    WITH CHECK (
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM users 
            WHERE auth_id = auth.uid() 
            AND role IN ('admin', 'manager')
        )
    );

-- Only admin/manager can update packages
CREATE POLICY flight_packages_update ON flight_packages
    FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
    USING (
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM users 
            WHERE auth_id = auth.uid() 
            AND role IN ('admin', 'manager')
        )
    );

-- Only admin can delete packages
CREATE POLICY flight_packages_delete ON flight_packages
    FOR DELETE TO authenticated
    USING (
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM users 
            WHERE auth_id = auth.uid() 
            AND role = 'admin'
        )
    );

-- Helper function to get package price
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_package_price(p_package_id UUID)
RETURNS DECIMAL AS $$
DECLARE
    pkg_price DECIMAL;
BEGIN
    SELECT price INTO pkg_price 
    FROM flight_packages 
    WHERE id = p_package_id;
    RETURN COALESCE(pkg_price, 0);
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Trigger to update passengers.selling_price when package is assigned
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_passenger_price_from_package()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    -- Only update if package_id changed and selling_price is not manually set
    IF NEW.package_id IS NOT NULL AND 
       (OLD.package_id IS NULL OR OLD.package_id != NEW.package_id) AND
       (NEW.selling_price IS NULL OR NEW.selling_price = 0) THEN
        NEW.selling_price := get_package_price(NEW.package_id);
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Drop trigger if exists and recreate
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_update_passenger_price ON passengers;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_update_passenger_price
    BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON passengers
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_passenger_price_from_package();

-- Add comments for documentation
COMMENT ON TABLE flight_packages IS 'Price packages available for each flight (e.g., Flight Only, Flight+Hotel, VIP)';
COMMENT ON COLUMN flight_packages.currency IS 'Price currency: ILS, EUR, USD';
COMMENT ON COLUMN flight_packages.event_ticket_category IS 'Category for event/match tickets: VIP, Standard, Premium, etc.';

        // ==========================================
        // Packages Management
        // ==========================================
        
        async function loadPackages() {
            const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
            const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
            const accessToken = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
            
            if (!supabaseUrl || !flightId) {
                renderPackages();
                return;
            }
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/flight_packages?flight_id=eq.${flightId}&order=sort_order,created_at`, {
                    headers: {
                        'apikey': supabaseKey,
                        'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`
                    }
                });
                
                if (res.ok) {
                    packages = await res.json();
                } else {
                    packages = [];
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error loading packages:', err);
                packages = [];
            }
            
            renderPackages();
        }
        
        function renderPackages() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('packagesGrid');
            const userRole = localStorage.getItem('userRole') || 'agent';
            const canEdit = ['admin', 'manager'].includes(userRole);
            
            // Count passengers per package
            const packageCounts = {};
            passengers.forEach(p => {
                if (p.package_id && p.status === 'active') {
                    packageCounts[p.package_id] = (packageCounts[p.package_id] || 0) + 1;
                }
            });
            
            let html = packages.map(pkg => {
                const count = packageCounts[pkg.id] || 0;
                const includes = [];
                
                if (pkg.includes_flight_outbound) includes.push({ icon: 'flight_takeoff', label: 'הלוך' });
                if (pkg.includes_flight_return) includes.push({ icon: 'flight_land', label: 'חזור' });
                if (pkg.includes_hotel) includes.push({ icon: 'hotel', label: `מלון${pkg.hotel_nights ? ` (${pkg.hotel_nights} לילות)` : ''}` });
                if (pkg.includes_event_ticket) includes.push({ icon: 'confirmation_number', label: pkg.event_ticket_category || 'כרטיס' });
                if (pkg.includes_transport) includes.push({ icon: 'directions_bus', label: 'הסעות' });
                if (pkg.includes_insurance) includes.push({ icon: 'health_and_safety', label: 'ביטוח' });
                
                return `
                    <div class="package-card" data-package-id="${pkg.id}">
                        ${count > 0 ? `<span class="package-count-badge">${count} נוסעים</span>` : ''}
                        <div class="package-card-header">
                            <h4 class="package-card-name">${escapeHtml(pkg.name)}</h4>
                            <div>
                                <span class="package-card-price">${pkg.price}</span>
                                <span class="package-card-currency">${pkg.currency}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        ${pkg.description ? `<p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--gray-dark); margin-bottom: 10px;">${escapeHtml(pkg.description)}</p>` : ''}
                        <div class="package-card-includes">
                            ${includes.map(inc => `
                                <span class="package-include-badge active">
                                    <span class="material-icons">${inc.icon}</span>
                                    ${inc.label}
                                </span>
                            `).join('')}
                        </div>
                        ${canEdit ? `

        async function savePackage(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            
            const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
            const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
            const accessToken = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
            
            const editingId = document.getElementById('editingPackageId').value;
            
            const packageData = {
                flight_id: flightId,
                name: document.getElementById('packageName').value.trim(),
                price: parseFloat(document.getElementById('packagePrice').value) || 0,
                currency: document.getElementById('packageCurrency').value,
                description: document.getElementById('packageDescription').value.trim() || null,
                event_ticket_category: document.getElementById('packageTicketCategory').value.trim() || null,
                max_quantity: document.getElementById('packageMaxQty').value ? parseInt(document.getElementById('packageMaxQty').value) : null,
                hotel_nights: document.getElementById('pkgHotel').checked ? (parseInt(document.getElementById('packageHotelNights').value) || 1) : null,
                includes_flight_outbound: document.getElementById('pkgOutbound').checked,
                includes_flight_return: document.getElementById('pkgReturn').checked,
                includes_hotel: document.getElementById('pkgHotel').checked,
                includes_event_ticket: document.getElementById('pkgEvent').checked,
                includes_transport: document.getElementById('pkgTransport').checked,
                includes_insurance: document.getElementById('pkgInsurance').checked
            };
            
            if (!supabaseUrl) {
                // Demo mode - add locally
                if (editingId) {
                    const idx = packages.findIndex(p => p.id === editingId);
                    if (idx >= 0) {
                        packages[idx] = { ...packages[idx], ...packageData };
                    }
                } else {
                    packages.push({ id: 'demo-' + Date.now(), ...packageData, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
                }
                closeModal('packageModal');
                renderPackages();
                showToast('החבילה נשמרה בהצלחה', 'success');
                return;
            }
            
            try {
                let res;
                if (editingId) {
                    // Update
                    res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/flight_packages?id=eq.${editingId}`, {
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        headers: {
                            'apikey': supabaseKey,
                            'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                            'Prefer': 'return=representation'
                        },
                        body: JSON.stringify(packageData)
                    });
                } else {
                    // Insert
                    res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/flight_packages`, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'apikey': supabaseKey,
                            'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                            'Prefer': 'return=representation'
                        },
                        body: JSON.stringify(packageData)
                    });
                }
                
                if (res.ok) {
                    closeModal('packageModal');
                    await loadPackages();
                    showToast(editingId ? 'החבילה עודכנה בהצלחה' : 'החבילה נוספה בהצלחה', 'success');
                } else {
                    const err = await res.json();
                    throw new Error(err.message || 'Failed to save package');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error saving package:', err);
                showToast('שגיאה בשמירת החבילה: ' + err.message, 'error');
            }
        }
        
        async function deletePackage(packageId) {
            if (!confirm('האם למחוק את החבילה? נוסעים המשויכים לחבילה זו יישארו ללא חבילה.')) {
                return;
            }
            
            const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
            const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
            const accessToken = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
            
            if (!supabaseUrl) {
                // Demo mode
                packages = packages.filter(p => p.id !== packageId);
                renderPackages();
                showToast('החבילה נמחקה', 'success');
                return;
            }
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/flight_packages?id=eq.${packageId}`, {
                    method: 'DELETE',
                    headers: {
                        'apikey': supabaseKey,
                        'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`
                    }
                });
                
                if (res.ok) {
                    await loadPackages();
                    showToast('החבילה נמחקה בהצלחה', 'success');
                } else {
                    throw new Error('Failed to delete package');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error deleting package:', err);
                showToast('שגיאה במחיקת החבילה', 'error');
            }
        }

        // Known header keywords for smart detection
        const knownHeaderKeywords = [
            'שם פרטי', 'שם משפחה', 'שם הסוכן', 'דוקט', 'טלפון', 
            'מלון', 'סיגמנט', 'הערות', 'הלוך', 'חזור', 'מחיר',
            'first', 'last', 'name', 'agent', 'phone', 'hotel'
        ];
        
        // Smart header row detection function
        function findHeaderRow(jsonData) {
            let bestRow = 0;
            let bestScore = 0;
            
            // Scan first 20 rows to find the one with most header matches
            const maxRowsToScan = Math.min(20, jsonData.length);
            
            for (let i = 0; i < maxRowsToScan; i++) {
                const row = jsonData[i];
                if (!row || !Array.isArray(row)) continue;
                
                // Convert row cells to strings and count matches
                let score = 0;
                row.forEach(cell => {
                    const cellStr = String(cell || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                    if (!cellStr) return;
                    
                    // Check if cell matches any known header keyword
                    for (const keyword of knownHeaderKeywords) {
                        if (cellStr.includes(keyword.toLowerCase())) {
                            score++;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Also check autoMappings keys
                    for (const key of Object.keys(autoMappings)) {
                        if (cellStr === key.toLowerCase() || cellStr.includes(key.toLowerCase())) {
                            score++;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                });
                
                // Update best if this row has more matches
                if (score > bestScore) {
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestRow = i;
                }
            }
            
            console.log(`[Import] Header row detected at index ${bestRow} with score ${bestScore}`);
            return bestRow;
        }

  new_string:         function parseExcel(data) {
            const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
            const firstSheet = workbook.Sheets[workbook.SheetNames[0]];
            const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(firstSheet, { header: 1 });
            
            if (jsonData.length < 2) {
                showToast('הקובץ ריק או לא תקין', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            // Smart header row detection - finds the row with most column header matches
            const headerRowIndex = findHeaderRow(jsonData);
            
            // Extract headers from the detected row
            importHeaders = jsonData[headerRowIndex].map(h => String(h || '').trim());
            
            // Extract data from rows after the header row, filter out empty rows
            importData = jsonData.slice(headerRowIndex + 1).filter(row => {
                // Filter out completely empty rows
                if (!row || !Array.isArray(row)) return false;
                // Keep rows that have at least one non-empty cell
                return row.some(cell => cell !== null && cell !== undefined && String(cell).trim() !== '');
            });
            
            // Auto-map columns
            autoMapColumns();
            
            const skippedRows = headerRowIndex > 0 ? ` (דילגנו על ${headerRowIndex} שורות כותרת)` : '';
            showToast(`נטענו ${importData.length} שורות${skippedRows}`, 'success');
            showImportStep(2);
        }

        // Populate package dropdown for import
        function populatePackageDropdown() {
            const select = document.getElementById('importDefaultPackage');
            if (!select) return;
            
            select.innerHTML = '<option value="">ללא חבילה (יוגדר מאוחר יותר)</option>';
            
            packages.forEach(pkg => {
                const priceText = `${pkg.price} ${pkg.currency}`;
                select.innerHTML += `<option value="${pkg.id}">${escapeHtml(pkg.name)} - ${priceText}</option>`;
            });
        }
        
        // Find package by name (for auto-matching from Excel)
        function findPackageByName(name) {
            if (!name) return null;
            const searchName = String(name).toLowerCase().trim();
            
            return packages.find(pkg => {
                const pkgName = pkg.name.toLowerCase().trim();
                // Exact match or partial match
                return pkgName === searchName || 
                       pkgName.includes(searchName) || 
                       searchName.includes(pkgName);
            });
        }

                            if (field === 'has_outbound' || field === 'has_return') {
                                value = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
                                passengerData[field] = value === 'v' || value === 'yes' || value === 'כן' || value === '1' || value === 'true';
                            } else if (field === 'price_paid') {
                                passengerData[field] = parseFloat(String(value).replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || null;
                            } else {

                                headers: {

                                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`,
                                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                                },
                                body: JSON.stringify(passengerData)
                            });
                            
                            if (response.ok) {
                                imported++;
                            } else {
                                failed++;
                            }

  new_string:         async function executeImport() {
            const firstNameCol = Object.entries(columnMapping).find(([k, v]) => v === 'first_name')?.[0];
            const lastNameCol = Object.entries(columnMapping).find(([k, v]) => v === 'last_name')?.[0];
            
            if (firstNameCol === undefined || lastNameCol === undefined) {
                showToast('חובה להתאים עמודות "שם פרטי" ו"שם משפחה"', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            // Get package settings
            const packageCol = Object.entries(columnMapping).find(([k, v]) => v === 'package_name')?.[0];
            const hasPackageColumn = packageCol !== undefined;
            const defaultPackageId = document.getElementById('importDefaultPackage')?.value || null;
            
            showLoading(true);
            
            let imported = 0;
            let failed = 0;
            let packagesMatched = 0;
            
            try {
                const supabaseUrl = localStorage.getItem('supabaseUrl');
                const supabaseKey = localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
                
                for (let i = 0; i < importData.length; i++) {
                    if (excludedRows.has(i)) continue;
                    
                    const row = importData[i];
                    const passengerData = {
                        flight_id: flightId,
                        first_name: String(row[firstNameCol] || '').trim(),
                        last_name: String(row[lastNameCol] || '').trim(),
                        source: 'excel_import',
                        status: 'active',
                        has_outbound: true,
                        has_return: true
                    };
                    
                    // Skip if no name
                    if (!passengerData.first_name || !passengerData.last_name) {
                        failed++;
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    // Handle package assignment
                    if (hasPackageColumn && packageCol !== undefined) {
                        // Try to match package from Excel column
                        const packageNameFromExcel = row[packageCol];
                        const matchedPackage = findPackageByName(packageNameFromExcel);
                        if (matchedPackage) {
                            passengerData.package_id = matchedPackage.id;
                            passengerData.selling_price = matchedPackage.price;
                            packagesMatched++;
                        }
                    } else if (defaultPackageId) {
                        // Use default package selected in dropdown
                        passengerData.package_id = defaultPackageId;
                        const defaultPkg = packages.find(p => p.id === defaultPackageId);
                        if (defaultPkg) {
                            passengerData.selling_price = defaultPkg.price;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Map other fields
                    Object.entries(columnMapping).forEach(([colIndex, field]) => {
                        if (field && field !== 'first_name' && field !== 'last_name' && field !== 'package_name') {
                            let value = row[colIndex];
                            
                            // Handle V marks for flight legs
                            if (field === 'has_outbound' || field === 'has_return') {
                                value = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
                                passengerData[field] = value === 'v' || value === 'yes' || value === 'כן' || value === '1' || value === 'true';
                            } else if (field === 'selling_price' || field === 'cost_price') {
                                // Only set price if not already set by package
                                if (!passengerData[field]) {
                                    passengerData[field] = parseFloat(String(value).replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || null;
                                }
                            } else {
                                passengerData[field] = value ? String(value).trim() : null;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    
                    if (supabaseUrl && supabaseKey) {
                        try {
                            const response = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/passengers`, {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: {
                                    'apikey': supabaseKey,
                                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`,
                                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                                },
                                body: JSON.stringify(passengerData)
                            });
                            
                            if (response.ok) {
                                imported++;
                            } else {
                                failed++;
                            }
                        } catch (e) {
                            failed++;
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Demo mode
                        passengerData.id = Date.now().toString() + i;
                        passengerData.created_at = new Date().toISOString();
                        passengers.push(passengerData);
                        imported++;
                    }
                }
                
                // Reload data
                await loadFlightData();
                
                // Show results with package info
                let resultText = `${imported} נוסעים יובאו בהצלחה`;
                if (failed > 0) resultText += `, ${failed} נכשלו`;
                if (packagesMatched > 0) resultText += ` | ${packagesMatched} שויכו לחבילות`;
                
                document.getElementById('importResultText').textContent = resultText;
                showImportStep(4);
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Import error:', error);
                showToast('שגיאה בייבוא: ' + error.message, 'error');
            } finally {
                showLoading(false);
            }
        }

## The Problem

The code was using `supabaseKey` (API key) in the `Authorization: Bearer` header instead of the actual `access_token` (JWT from login).

- **API key** = just an identifier, NOT a JWT (doesn't have 3 parts)
- **access_token** = actual JWT from login (has 3 dot-separated parts)

## The Fix

Changed all Authorization headers from:
```javascript
'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseKey}`  // WRONG
```
To:
```javascript
'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access_token') || supabaseKey}`  // CORRECT
```

[Tool call] CreatePlan
  name: Fix Excel Import Duplicate Rows Bug
  overview: Fix the bug where Excel import shows duplicate rows and prompts multiple times, caused by multiple event handlers and missing file input reset.
  plan: # Fix Excel Import Duplicate Rows Bug

## Root Causes Identified

1. **File input not reset** - When re-uploading the same file, the `onchange` event may not fire properly. The file input value needs to be cleared after processing.

2. **Multiple XLSX script loads** - Each time a file is uploaded before XLSX is loaded, a new `<script>` tag is appended, potentially causing multiple `parseExcel` calls.

3. **Click handler on uploadArea** - The `uploadArea.onclick` is set every time the modal opens, but also the area contains a button with its own click handler, potentially causing double triggers.

## Fixes to Apply

### Fix 1: Reset file input after processing

In [flight-detail.html](flight-detail.html), update `processImportFile()`:

```javascript
function processImportFile(file) {
    // Clear file input to allow re-uploading same file
    document.getElementById('importFileInput').value = '';
    // ... rest of function
}
```

### Fix 2: Prevent duplicate XLSX script loading

Add a flag to track if XLSX is loading:

```javascript
let xlsxLoading = false;

function processImportFile(file) {
    // ... existing code ...
    if (typeof XLSX === 'undefined' && !xlsxLoading) {
        xlsxLoading = true;
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.onload = () => {
            xlsxLoading = false;
            parseExcel(e.target.result);
        };
        // ...
    }
}
```

### Fix 3: Fix uploadArea click handling

Stop event propagation on the button to prevent double handling:

```html
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" 
    onclick="event.stopPropagation(); document.getElementById('importFileInput').click()">
```

### Fix 4: Clear importData on modal open

Ensure `importData` is cleared properly:

```javascript
function openImportModal() {
    importData = [];
    importHeaders = [];
    columnMapping = {};
    excludedRows = new Set();
    // Also reset file input
    document.getElementById('importFileInput').value = '';
    // ...
}
```

### 2. Add Gemini OCR Function

Create function to call Gemini Vision API:

```javascript
async function processOCRFile(file) {
    const geminiKey = localStorage.getItem('geminiApiKey');
    if (!geminiKey) {
        showToast('נא להגדיר Gemini API Key בהגדרות', 'error');
        return;
    }
    
    // Convert file to base64
    const base64 = await fileToBase64(file);
    
    // Call Gemini Vision API with structured prompt
    const response = await fetch(`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=${geminiKey}`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            contents: [{
                parts: [
                    { text: "Extract passenger data from this image as JSON array..." },
                    { inline_data: { mime_type: file.type, data: base64 } }
                ]
            }]
        })
    });
    
    // Parse response and convert to importData format
}
```

### 3. Gemini Prompt for Data Extraction

The prompt will instruct Gemini to:
- Identify table structure in the image
- Extract columns: name, phone, agent, hotel, etc.
- Return structured JSON array
- Handle Hebrew text properly

```javascript
// Listen for paste events in import modal
document.addEventListener('paste', async (e) => {
    const importModal = document.getElementById('importModal');
    if (!importModal.classList.contains('show')) return;
    
    const items = e.clipboardData?.items;
    for (const item of items) {
        if (item.type.startsWith('image/')) {
            const file = item.getAsFile();
            await processOCRImage(file);
            break;
        }
    }
});
```

```javascript
async function processOCRImage(file) {
    showOCRProcessing(file);
    
    const geminiKey = localStorage.getItem('geminiApiKey');
    const base64 = await fileToBase64(file);
    
    const response = await fetch(
        `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=${geminiKey}`,
        {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                contents: [{
                    parts: [
                        { text: OCR_EXTRACTION_PROMPT },
                        { inline_data: { mime_type: file.type, data: base64 } }
                    ]
                }]
            })
        }
    );
    
    const data = await response.json();
    const extractedData = parseGeminiResponse(data);
    convertToImportFormat(extractedData);
}
```

```javascript
const OCR_EXTRACTION_PROMPT = `
Extract ALL passenger data from this image as a JSON array.

Return ONLY valid JSON in this format:
[
  {"first_name": "...", "last_name": "...", "agent": "...", "hotel": "...", "phone": "..."},
  ...
]

Important:
- Extract ALL rows, not just a sample
- Handle Hebrew text correctly
- If a field is empty, use null
- Return ONLY the JSON array, no explanation
`;
```

        // Listen for paste events (Ctrl+V)
        document.addEventListener('paste', async (e) => {
            const importModal = document.getElementById('importModal');
            if (!importModal || !importModal.classList.contains('show')) return;
            
            const items = e.clipboardData?.items;
            if (!items) return;
            
            for (const item of items) {
                if (item.type.startsWith('image/')) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const file = item.getAsFile();
                    if (file) {
                        await processOCRImage(file);
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Convert file to base64
        function fileToBase64(file) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = () => {
                    const base64 = reader.result.split(',')[1];
                    resolve(base64);
                };
                reader.onerror = reject;
                reader.readAsDataURL(file);
            });
        }
        
        // Show OCR processing UI
        function showOCRProcessing(file) {
            document.getElementById('uploadArea').style.display = 'none';
            document.querySelector('.paste-hint').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('ocrProcessing').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('ocrError').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('ocrStatusText').textContent = 'מעבד תמונה עם AI...';
            
            // Show preview
            const preview = document.getElementById('ocrPreview');
            preview.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        }
        
        // Process image with Gemini OCR
        async function processOCRImage(file) {
            if (ocrProcessing) {
                console.log('OCR already processing...');
                return;
            }
            
            const geminiKey = localStorage.getItem('geminiApiKey');
            if (!geminiKey) {
                showToast('נא להגדיר Gemini API Key בהגדרות', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            ocrProcessing = true;
            showOCRProcessing(file);
            
            try {
                // Convert to base64
                const base64 = await fileToBase64(file);
                
                // Call Gemini Vision API
                const response = await fetch(
                    `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=${geminiKey}`,
                    {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            contents: [{
                                parts: [
                                    { text: OCR_EXTRACTION_PROMPT },
                                    { 
                                        inline_data: { 
                                            mime_type: file.type || 'image/png', 
                                            data: base64 
                                        } 
                                    }
                                ]
                            }],
                            generationConfig: {
                                temperature: 0.1,
                                maxOutputTokens: 8192
                            }
                        })
                    }
                );
                
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(`Gemini API error: ${response.status}`);
                }
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                // Extract text from response
                const text = data.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
                if (!text) {
                    throw new Error('No response from Gemini');
                }
                
                // Parse the JSON response
                parseOCRResponse(text);
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('OCR Error:', error);
                document.getElementById('ocrError').textContent = `שגיאה: ${error.message}`;
                document.getElementById('ocrError').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('ocrStatusText').textContent = 'העיבוד נכשל';
            } finally {
                ocrProcessing = false;
            }
        }
        
        // Parse Gemini OCR response and convert to import format
        function parseOCRResponse(text) {
            try {
                // Clean up the response - remove markdown code blocks if present
                let jsonText = text.trim();
                if (jsonText.startsWith('```json')) {
                    jsonText = jsonText.slice(7);
                }
                if (jsonText.startsWith('```')) {
                    jsonText = jsonText.slice(3);
                }
                if (jsonText.endsWith('```')) {
                    jsonText = jsonText.slice(0, -3);
                }
                jsonText = jsonText.trim();
                
                // Parse JSON
                const data = JSON.parse(jsonText);
                
                if (!data.headers || !data.rows) {
                    throw new Error('Invalid response format');
                }
                
                if (data.rows.length === 0) {
                    throw new Error('לא נמצאו נתונים בתמונה');
                }
                
                // Convert to import format
                importHeaders = data.headers.map(h => String(h || '').trim());
                importData = data.rows.filter(row => {
                    if (!row || !Array.isArray(row)) return false;
                    return row.some(cell => cell !== null && cell !== undefined && String(cell).trim() !== '');
                });
                
                // Auto-map columns
                autoMapColumns();
                
                showToast(`זוהו ${importData.length} שורות מהתמונה`, 'success');
                
                // Move to step 2 (column mapping)
                showImportStep(2);
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Parse OCR Error:', error);
                document.getElementById('ocrError').textContent = `שגיאה בעיבוד התוצאות: ${error.message}`;
                document.getElementById('ocrError').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('ocrStatusText').textContent = 'העיבוד נכשל';
            }
        }

        }

  old_string:     <script>
        // ==========================================
        // State
        // ==========================================
        let flightId = null;
  new_string:     <script>
        // ==========================================
        // Helper: Get Access Token
        // ==========================================
        function getAccessToken() {
            // Try direct access_token first
            let token = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
            if (token) return token;
            
            // Fall back to userSession
            try {
                const session = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('userSession') || '{}');
                if (session.access_token) {
                    // Also save directly for future use
                    localStorage.setItem('access_token', session.access_token);
                    return session.access_token;
                }
            } catch (e) {}
            
            // Return API key as last resort
            return localStorage.getItem('supabaseKey');
        }
        
        // ==========================================
        // State
        // ==========================================
        let flightId = null;

    // Generate Transport Manifest (for bus companies)
    // Sorted by hotel for efficient pickup route
    function generateTransportManifest(passengers, flight, options = {}) {
        const docNumber = options.docNumber || generateDocNumber('list');
        const transportType = options.transportType || 'הסעות';
        
        // Sort by hotel name for efficient pickup route
        const sortedPassengers = [...passengers].sort((a, b) => {
            const hotelA = (a.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון').toLowerCase();
            const hotelB = (b.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון').toLowerCase();
            return hotelA.localeCompare(hotelB, 'he');
        });
        
        // Count by hotel for summary
        const hotelCounts = {};
        sortedPassengers.forEach(p => {
            const hotel = p.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון';
            hotelCounts[hotel] = (hotelCounts[hotel] || 0) + 1;
        });
        
        const passengerRows = sortedPassengers.map((p, i) => `
            <tr>
                <td>${i + 1}</td>
                <td><strong>${p.first_name} ${p.last_name}</strong></td>
                <td>${p.phone || '-'}</td>
                <td>${p.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון'}</td>
                <td>${p.special_notes || '-'}</td>
            </tr>
        `).join('');
        
        const hotelSummary = Object.entries(hotelCounts).map(([hotel, count]) => `
            <div class="stat-item">
                <span class="stat-label">${hotel}:</span>
                <span class="stat-value">${count}</span>
            </div>
        `).join('');
        
        return `

  new_string:     // Generate Hotel List (grouped by hotel) - Enhanced with check-in/out dates
    function generateHotelList(passengers, flight, options = {}) {
        const docNumber = options.docNumber || generateDocNumber('list');
        
        // Group by hotel
        const hotels = {};
        passengers.forEach(p => {
            const hotelName = p.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון';
            if (!hotels[hotelName]) hotels[hotelName] = [];
            hotels[hotelName].push(p);
        });
        
        // Calculate nights
        const checkIn = new Date(flight.departure_date);
        const checkOut = new Date(flight.return_date);
        const nights = Math.ceil((checkOut - checkIn) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        
        const hotelSections = Object.entries(hotels).map(([hotelName, guests]) => `
            <div class="hotel-section">
                <div class="hotel-header">
                    <h4>🏨 ${hotelName}</h4>
                    <div class="hotel-stats">
                        <span class="guest-count">${guests.length} אורחים</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="hotel-dates">
                    <span><strong>Check-in:</strong> ${formatDate(flight.departure_date)}</span>
                    <span><strong>Check-out:</strong> ${formatDate(flight.return_date)}</span>
                    <span><strong>לילות:</strong> ${nights}</span>
                </div>
                <table>
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th>#</th>
                            <th>שם אורח</th>
                            <th>טלפון</th>
                            <th>מס׳ אישור</th>
                            <th>קבוצת חדר</th>
                            <th>בקשות מיוחדות</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        ${guests.map((p, i) => `
                            <tr>
                                <td>${i + 1}</td>
                                <td><strong>${p.first_name} ${p.last_name}</strong></td>
                                <td>${p.phone || '-'}</td>
                                <td>${p.hotel_booking_ref || '-'}</td>
                                <td>${p.room_group_name || '-'}</td>
                                <td>${p.special_notes || '-'}</td>
                            </tr>
                        `).join('')}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        `).join('');
        
        // Summary stats
        const totalGuests = passengers.length;
        const hotelCount = Object.keys(hotels).filter(h => h !== 'ללא מלון').length;
        
        return `

            <html lang="he" dir="rtl">
            <head>

    // ==========================================
    // EXCEL EXPORT
    // ==========================================
    
    // Export data to Excel file
    // columns: array of { key: 'fieldName', header: 'Hebrew Header' }
    function exportToExcel(data, columns, filename) {
        // Ensure XLSX is loaded
        if (typeof XLSX === 'undefined') {
            alert('שגיאה: ספריית Excel לא נטענה. נסה לרענן את הדף.');
            return;
        }
        
        // Create header row
        const headers = columns.map(c => c.header);
        
        // Create data rows
        const rows = data.map(item => 
            columns.map(c => {
                const value = item[c.key];
                if (value === true) return '✓';
                if (value === false) return '-';
                if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
                return value;
            })
        );
        
        // Combine headers and data
        const wsData = [headers, ...rows];
        
        // Create worksheet
        const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(wsData);
        
        // Auto-size columns
        const colWidths = columns.map((col, i) => {
            const headerLen = col.header.length;
            const maxDataLen = Math.max(...rows.map(row => String(row[i] || '').length));
            return { wch: Math.max(headerLen, maxDataLen, 10) + 2 };
        });
        ws['!cols'] = colWidths;
        
        // Create workbook
        const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
        XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'רשימה');
        
        // Generate filename with date
        const date = new Date();
        const dateStr = `${date.getFullYear()}-${(date.getMonth()+1).toString().padStart(2,'0')}-${date.getDate().toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;
        const fullFilename = `${filename}-${dateStr}.xlsx`;
        
        // Download
        XLSX.writeFile(wb, fullFilename);
    }
    
    // Export passenger list to Excel
    function exportPassengerListToExcel(passengers, flight) {
        const columns = [
            { key: '_index', header: '#' },
            { key: 'first_name', header: 'שם פרטי' },
            { key: 'last_name', header: 'שם משפחה' },
            { key: 'phone', header: 'טלפון' },

            { key: 'hotel_name', header: 'מלון' },
            { key: 'hotel_booking_ref', header: 'אישור מלון' },
            { key: 'agent_name', header: 'סוכן' }
        ];
        
        const data = passengers.map((p, i) => ({ ...p, _index: i + 1 }));
        exportToExcel(data, columns, `passengers-${flight.destination}`);
    }
    
    // Export airline manifest to Excel
    function exportAirlineManifestToExcel(passengers, flight, options = {}) {
        const leg = options.leg || 'both';
        
        let filteredPassengers = passengers;
        let legName = 'all';
        
        if (leg === 'outbound') {
            filteredPassengers = passengers.filter(p => p.has_outbound !== false);
            legName = 'outbound';
        } else if (leg === 'return') {
            filteredPassengers = passengers.filter(p => p.has_return !== false);
            legName = 'return';
        }
        
        const columns = [
            { key: '_index', header: '#' },
            { key: 'first_name', header: 'שם פרטי' },
            { key: 'last_name', header: 'שם משפחה' },
            { key: 'phone', header: 'טלפון' },
            { key: 'has_outbound', header: 'הלוך' },
            { key: 'has_return', header: 'חזור' },
            { key: 'booking_ref', header: 'מס׳ הזמנה / PNR' },
            { key: 'special_notes', header: 'הערות' }
        ];
        
        const data = filteredPassengers.map((p, i) => ({ ...p, _index: i + 1 }));
        exportToExcel(data, columns, `airline-manifest-${legName}-${flight.destination}`);
    }
    
    // Export hotel list to Excel
    function exportHotelListToExcel(passengers, flight) {
        const columns = [
            { key: '_index', header: '#' },
            { key: 'first_name', header: 'שם פרטי' },
            { key: 'last_name', header: 'שם משפחה' },
            { key: 'phone', header: 'טלפון' },
            { key: 'hotel_name', header: 'מלון' },
            { key: 'hotel_booking_ref', header: 'מס׳ אישור' },
            { key: 'room_group_name', header: 'קבוצת חדר' },
            { key: 'special_notes', header: 'בקשות מיוחדות' }
        ];
        
        // Sort by hotel name
        const sortedPassengers = [...passengers].sort((a, b) => {
            const hotelA = (a.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון').toLowerCase();
            const hotelB = (b.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון').toLowerCase();
            return hotelA.localeCompare(hotelB, 'he');
        });
        
        const data = sortedPassengers.map((p, i) => ({ ...p, _index: i + 1 }));
        exportToExcel(data, columns, `hotel-list-${flight.destination}`);
    }
    
    // Export transport manifest to Excel
    function exportTransportManifestToExcel(passengers, flight) {
        const columns = [
            { key: '_index', header: '#' },
            { key: 'first_name', header: 'שם פרטי' },
            { key: 'last_name', header: 'שם משפחה' },
            { key: 'phone', header: 'טלפון' },
            { key: 'hotel_name', header: 'נקודת איסוף / מלון' },
            { key: 'special_notes', header: 'הערות' }
        ];
        
        // Sort by hotel name for efficient pickup route
        const sortedPassengers = [...passengers].sort((a, b) => {
            const hotelA = (a.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון').toLowerCase();
            const hotelB = (b.hotel_name || 'ללא מלון').toLowerCase();
            return hotelA.localeCompare(hotelB, 'he');
        });
        
        const data = sortedPassengers.map((p, i) => ({ ...p, _index: i + 1 }));
        exportToExcel(data, columns, `transport-${flight.destination}`);
    }
